name: CloseResource
message: Ensure that resources like this {0} object are closed after use
suppress:
let $name := string(@Name),
    $scope := ancestor::Block[1],
    $init := parent::VariableDeclarator/*[2],
    $fields := ancestor::ClassBody[1]/FieldDeclaration/VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name
return .[
  $init[self::ConstructorCall][pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.util.Formatter')]
    [empty(ArgumentList/*) or ArgumentList/*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.StringBuilder')
                                               or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.StringBuffer')]]
  or exists($init/(self::MethodCall | self::CastExpression/MethodCall)[@MethodName = ('unwrap', 'getCurrentSession')
       or (@MethodName = 'getConnection' and *[1][self::TypeExpression/ClassType/@SimpleName = 'DataSourceUtils'])
       or (@MethodName = 'get' and *[1][self::TypeExpression/ClassType/@SimpleName = 'GlobalTracer'])
       or (@MethodName = 'putCloseable' and *[1][self::TypeExpression/ClassType/@SimpleName = 'MDC'])])
  or exists($scope//MethodCall[@MethodName = ('shutdown', 'shutdownNow')][*[1][self::VariableAccess[@Name = $name]]])
  or exists($scope//MethodCall[@MethodName = ('close', 'closeQuietly', 'closeSilently', 'closeStream', 'closeResource')]
       [ancestor::FinallyClause][ArgumentList/VariableAccess[@Name = $name]])
  or exists($scope//MethodCall[@MethodName = 'renderBinary']/ArgumentList/VariableAccess[@Name = $name])
  or exists($scope//AssignmentExpression[*[2][self::VariableAccess[@Name = $name]]]
       [*[1][self::FieldAccess[*[1][self::ThisExpression]]]
        or *[1][self::VariableAccess[@Name = $fields]]])
]

name: UnitTestShouldIncludeAssert
message: This unit test should include assert() or fail()
suppress:
.[.//LambdaExpression//MethodCall[matches(@MethodName,
    '^(assert.*|fail|verify.*|andExpect(All)?|should(HaveNo.*)?|expect(Status|Body|Header|Next.*|Complete|Error.*)|toMatchSnapshot|matchesSnapshot)$')]]
| .[let $method := .,
        $classes := ancestor::ClassDeclaration,
        $callback := function($type) {
          exists($type[pmd-java:typeIs('org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.AfterEachCallback')
                       or pmd-java:typeIs('org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.AfterTestExecutionCallback')]
                      [not(pmd-java:typeIs('org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension')
                           or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.test.context.junit.jupiter.SpringExtension'))]) }
    return exists(FormalParameters/FormalParameter[not(ModifierList/Annotation)]
                    [let $name := VariableId/@Name
                     return exists($method/Block//MethodCall[*[1][self::VariableAccess][@Name = $name]])])
      and (some $type in ($classes/ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName = 'ExtendWith']//ClassLiteral/ClassType,
                          $classes/ClassBody/FieldDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation/@SimpleName = 'RegisterExtension']/ClassType)
           satisfies $callback($type))]
